_comment: The naive Gaussian model's guesser made literal: Numberbatch z over the online 800 words (clue_stats_online) plus N(0, sigma^2) noise, fixed per (clue, word). Not a pool for training; for checking the Gaussian spymaster in a world where its model is exactly true (docs/log.md, 2026-11-10). Use with --guesser-pool-config configs/guesser_gaussian.json --guesser gaussian_numberbatch_s2.
